reasons.plausibility: Minor Cu additions to improve ductility while retaining magnetocaloric properties are consistent with known metallurgical strategies, although the precise effect on MnNiSi-based alloys remains partly uncertain.
reasons.testability: Comparative synthesis of doped vs. undoped samples with defined acceptance criteria for mechanical and magnetocaloric improvements provides a direct and decisive test.
reasons.usefulness: Addressing mechanical reliability without sacrificing magnetocaloric performance is a key challenge for MnNiSi-based materials, making this hypothesis relevant and practically valuable to researchers.
